steps.caption: The route loader fetches the PlanView before the page renders.
Submitting the form calls a server function with the thread id and the decision.
lib/api.ts is the only door to data, and it is the service binding.
Hono validates the envelope and reads this participant's flags from D1.
The Durable Object dispatches the command with the flags as plain names.
The decider decides, the events append in one block, and the page reloads.
In dev the Agentation toolbar lets you point at what looks wrong.
